_note: Map events ('?' stops), after Slay the Spire's events: a short scene and 2 or 3 choices with trade-offs. Effects are applied by scripts/run.gd (apply_effect), which also adds the safety conditions: no option may put out the last candle or shrink the deck below run.gd's DECK_MIN. 'if' on an event decides whether it can appear; on an option, whether it can be chosen. Effects: add (card name), add_random (n cards from the card-choice pool), add_from (a dealer deck in data/run.json), lose_random (n), candles (+/-n), mark (bones: you open each hand with n more bones; tilt: each hand starts with the scale tipped n against you; dealer_draw: the Dealer opens each hand with n more cards), cleanse (clears tilt and dealer_draw), cut_wire (you cut one of the Dealer's intact wires), pick (remove | transform | duplicate: you then choose a card from your deck), gamble (weighted outcomes, each with its own effects and result). Conditions: candles_min, candles_below_max, curse, wire_intact, deck_min.

ledger.title: The Ledger
ledger.text: The Dealer's ledger lies open between you. Your name is already half written in it, in a hand that is not yours.

options.label: Finish the signature
options.result: The ink is still wet. Somewhere behind you a candle sighs and goes out.

options.label: Strike out a line
options.effect_text: Remove a card. The Dealer opens each hand with a card more.
options.result: The Dealer watches you scratch it out. It turns the page and writes something new.

options.label: Close the book
options.result: It lets you close it. This time.

spare_wax.title: Spare Wax
spare_wax.text: Under the table you find a stub of a fourth candle, soft and still warm.

options.label: Relight a candle
options.result: You press the stub onto a dead wick. It catches.

options.label: Seal a card with it
options.effect_text: Duplicate a card in your deck.
options.result: The wax takes the card's shape and keeps it.

options.label: Leave it
options.result: Wax is wax.

bone_dice.title: Bone Dice
bone_dice.text: The Dealer rolls two knucklebones across the table and taps the wood twice. A game before the game.

options.label: Bet a candle
options.effect_text: Half: gain Ghoul and Hydra. Half: lose a candle.

gamble.result: Double sixes. The Dealer pays without a word.
Snake eyes. The Dealer leans over and pinches out a flame.

options.label: Bet a card
options.effect_text: Lose a random card. Half: gain two random cards.

gamble.result: You win. It deals you two cards, face down.
You lose. Your card goes into its sleeve.

options.label: Decline
options.result: It gathers the bones back up. Patient.

music_box.title: The Music Box
music_box.text: A walnut music box on the shelf plays a tune you almost remember. The comb is missing teeth.

options.label: Wind it
options.result: The tune changes, and so does the card in your hand.

options.label: Smash it
options.effect_text: Open each hand with 2 more bones. Each hand starts with the scale tipped 1 against you.
options.result: Splinters and tiny bones. The Dealer's scale creaks toward itself.

options.label: Let it wind down
options.result: The last note hangs for a long time.

loose_gear.title: A Loose Gear
loose_gear.text: A brass gear drops out of the Dealer's chest and rolls to your side of the table. It does not seem to notice.

options.label: Pocket it
options.effect_text: Open each hand with 1 more bone.
options.result: It is warm, and it ticks faintly in your pocket.

options.label: Jam it in its wires
options.effect_text: Cut one of the Dealer's wires.
options.result: Something inside the Dealer snaps. It blinks, slowly.

options.label: Hand it back
options.result: The Dealer takes it with two fingers. Its scale settles level.

dozing.title: The Dealer Dozes
dozing.text: The ticking slows. The Dealer's head tilts forward and the lid of its skull hangs a little open.

options.label: Pull a wire
options.effect_text: Cut a wire. Lose a candle.
options.result: The wire comes away hot. Your sleeve brushes a candle out.

options.label: Steal from its hand
options.effect_text: Gain a card from the Dealer's best deck. Each hand starts with the scale tipped 1 against you.
options.result: You slip a card out. One eye opens.

options.label: Let it sleep
options.result: It wakes as if it never slept.

empty_chair.title: The Empty Chair
empty_chair.text: A third chair has been pulled up to the table. A hand of cards waits on it, still warm from someone's grip.

options.label: Take their hand
options.effect_text: Gain two random cards. The Dealer opens each hand with a card more.
options.result: Whoever sat there is not coming back for them.

options.label: Trade a card
options.effect_text: Remove a card. Gain a random card.
options.result: You leave one of yours on the chair. It is gone when you look again.

options.label: Leave it be
options.result: You do not look at the chair again.

rats.title: Rats in the Walls
rats.text: Something scratches in the bracken behind you, close to the ground. Many somethings.

options.label: Open the wall
options.effect_text: 3 in 5: gain two Rats and a Vulture. Else the Dealer opens each hand with a card more.

gamble.result: They pour out and into your deck.
They pour out and into the Dealer's sleeves.

options.label: Feed them a card
options.result: The scratching stops. For now.

options.label: Ignore it
options.result: It goes on all night.

basin.title: The Black Basin
basin.text: A basin of still black water sits by the door. Your reflection in it is holding different cards.

options.label: Wash your hands
options.result: The water clouds. Your hands feel lighter.

options.label: Drink
options.effect_text: Gain a candle. Each hand starts with the scale tipped 1 against you.
options.result: It tastes of smoke. A dead wick flickers back to life.

options.label: Swap with your reflection
options.result: Your reflection smiles. You do not.

squirrel_cage.title: The Squirrel Cage
squirrel_cage.text: A wire cage of squirrels hangs from the rafters, the Dealer's endless supply. The latch is loose.

options.label: Let them go
options.effect_text: Lose 2 random cards. Remove your curses.
options.result: They scatter. The Dealer's scale rattles, then rights itself.

options.label: Keep one
options.result: The cat was in the cage all along.

options.label: Leave the latch
options.result: They watch you go.
